answer.rationale: Compliance forbids reverting the security patch, so rollback is off the table. Circuit breaking would fail writes at settlement peak and conflicts with not losing customer writes. The same release is likely in every region, so failover may not fix a code or load regression. Write-path p99 is 5x under heavy peak writes; inherited capacity-headroom experience is the closest match, though that case was pre-peak provisioning and may not fully apply mid-surge. Scale enough to matter but not a blind fleet-wide change; cause (release efficiency vs saturation vs something regional) remains uncertain.
